_readme: Rental-location map pins for the Rental Calendar's map panel, keyed by org slug
then by Rec locationId (stable across renames — 'BB&N Turf Fields' was renamed to
'BB&N Grove Street Athletic Fields' in Rec and the pin followed without a change here).
Coordinates were geocoded once (OpenStreetMap/Nominatim) and committed, so the page
never depends on a geocoder at runtime — same approach as campmap-seeds.json.
Park entries use the OSM park feature (the park itself); street-addressed entries use
the address. Admins can drag any pin to correct it; those overrides are stored per-org
in DATA_DIR/rental_map_positions.json and win over the values here.
A location with no entry simply gets no pin — the panel lists it as unmapped rather
than guessing. Watertown's 'Permit Applications' is deliberately omitted: it is an
administrative pseudo-location for bulk permit requests, not a physical place.
'label' is only a human hint for whoever edits this file; the UI shows Rec's live
locationName so a rename in Rec is reflected without touching this file.
